veranderings.voor: in die son, en word hulle meer werd
veranderings.na: in die son, en hulle word meer werd
veranderings.rede: After the coordinating 'en' a new main clause normally takes subject-verb order; 'en word hulle' reads stiff.

veranderings.voor: na die hawe en per skip weg
veranderings.na: na die hawe en van daar per skip weg
veranderings.rede: Makes clear that the ship leaves from the harbour, so the two transport legs read in sequence rather than as alternatives.

veranderings.blok: Wat dit langs die pad kos
veranderings.voor: Die dae van gis en droog
veranderings.na: Die dae wat die bone gis en droog
veranderings.rede: Bare verbs used as nouns after 'van' are awkward; a short clause is natural and stays within the list allowance.
